mod.lora.parsing: Preamble/SFD, BW and SF estimates. Payload and sync word are not decoded.
mod.lora.effect: BW {bandwidths} kHz · SF{sf_min}–{sf_max}. Overlapping analysis channels cover Search width. Source rates are converted internally; complete signals must fit inside the sampled edges.
mod.narrow.parsing: Modulation candidates and measured features. No protocol or payload decoder.
mod.narrow.effect: Continuous narrowband analysis within Search width. Signal bandwidth, level and transitions must match the detector; edge signals may be incomplete.
mod.fm.parsing: Stereo-pilot evidence and FM audio demodulation. No message decoding.
mod.fm.effect: 65–110 MHz only; a complete 200 kHz channel must fit inside the sampled band. Edge channels may be excluded.
mod.ofdm.parsing: Cyclic-prefix structure and symbol timing. Subcarrier data and payload are not decoded.
mod.ofdm.effect: Triggered snapshots of the full receiver band; Search width does not crop this detector. Requires repeated cyclic prefixes and a complete signal in the receiver passband.
mod.css.parsing: Repeated chirps, sweep bandwidth and period. No protocol or payload decoding.
mod.css.effect: Triggered snapshots; chirp centers are limited by Search width. Detects repeated sweeps spanning at least 40 kHz, not every CSS waveform.
mod.css.impact: Triggered · Sweeps of at least 40 kHz
mod.four_fsk.parsing: Four frequency clusters and deviation estimates. No protocol or payload decoding.
mod.four_fsk.effect: Triggered snapshots with approximately 38 kHz channel filtering. Only supported narrowband bursts inside Search width are candidates; snapshots can miss short or continuous signals.
mod.psk.parsing: Phase constellation and symbol-rate candidates. No protocol or payload decoding.
mod.psk.effect: Triggered snapshots with approximately 38 kHz channel filtering. Only supported narrowband bursts inside Search width are candidates; snapshots can miss short or continuous signals.
mod.fm.outside: The search range does not intersect 65–110 MHz, the broadcast FM detector's supported band.
